defective_pattern: Omitting mandatory visual deliverables, specifically SEM structural path diagram figures (via semPlot or matplotlib), when formulating delegation scopes for simulation or data tasks.
why_defective: Failing to explicitly require SEM structural path diagrams in the delegation envelope causes downstream data-agents to skip generating them. Consequently, validation-agents lack specific assertions to check for their presence, causing the omission to slip past quality control gates.
observed_symptoms: Absence of high-resolution SEM path diagrams in deliverables
Validation-agent passes audit without checking for figure artifacts
Delegation instructions lacking explicit figure generation requirements
corrective_remedy: Explicitly include mandatory visual deliverables (like SEM path diagrams) in the delegation envelope for relevant stages. Ensure the data-agent knows it must generate them, and update validation-agent checks to assert the existence of expected figure artifacts in the deliverables directory before passing the audit.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Absence of expected .png/.pdf SEM path diagrams in deliverables directory when executing SEM tasks, coupled with passing validation audits.
